fullDescription:
Bring organic serenity, high-fashion grace, and airy minimalism to your layout design with Rahena! Crafted by Muflieart as a modern serif display font, its refined letterforms feature high-contrast stems, delicate curved ascenders, sweeping tail accents, and open geometric proportions. Its tranquil, high-end silhouette brings an instant feeling of calm luxury to every title.

Perfect for luxury wellness branding, home fragrance packaging, high-end cosmetics logos, spa brand identities, aesthetic quote layouts, and chic editorial titles!
